sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The petitioner is before this Court seeking transit bail apprehending arrest in FIR No.223/2023 registered by Cyber Crime Police Station, Cyberabad, Telangana.

2. The aforementioned FIR was registered on a complaint lodged by one Gopavarappa Venkateswarlu for offence punishable under Section 420,463,468 of IPC, 66- C, 66-D of Information Technology Act, 2008.

3. As per complaint averments the suspected accused named in the FIR added the complainant in a whatsapp group by name "PROFITGAINS01" and induced him to invest a total sum of Rs.5,40,000/- and thereafter cheated him by not refunding the amount.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that a notice was issued under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. to the petitioner though she is innocent of the alleged offences and therefore, she apprehends arrest in this case.
He would also contend that the name of the petitioner is not forthcoming in the FIR and she being a woman, if she is arrested, she will be put to untold misery and hardship.
Therefore, he seeks to grant bail to the petitioner for a limited period to approach the jurisdictional Court.

5. A perusal of the notice issued under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. reveals that the petitioner was directed to appear before the concerned police on 01.04.2023 stating that if she failed to attend, she would be liable for arrest under Section 41-A (3) and (4) of Cr.P.C. Since there is no compliance to the said notice by the petitioner, there is a reasonable apprehension of her arrest.
The allegations in the complaint with regard to the petitioner is concerned is yet to be ascertained.

6. Hence, it is just and proper to provide an opportunity to the petitioner to approach the jurisdictional Court for appropriate relief seeking anticipatory bail and for the said purpose, she may be granted transit bail for a limited period so as to protect her rights.

The petitioner may approach the jurisdictional Court for appropriate relief seeking anticipatory bail within a period of one month from today and it is directed that till such period, in the event of her arrest in the above noted FIR, she shall be released on executing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only).
